## ◎ THE OMNIS VOTING SYSTEM

### 43 Cores
All 43 cores hold a phase angle θᵢ. On every heartbeat, each core updates its phase and casts a vote vector.

```javascript
// Kuramoto model: coupled oscillators
// dθᵢ/dt = ωᵢ + (K/N) * Σⱼ sin(θⱼ - θᵢ)
// K = coupling strength (0.5 baseline)
// ωᵢ = natural frequency of core i (PHI-scaled from 7.83 Hz)
// N = 43

const R = Math.abs(
  cores.reduce((sum, c) => sum + Math.cos(c.phase), 0) / 43
); // Kuramoto coherence order parameter

const CONVERGENCE_THRESHOLD = 0.82; // R > 0.82 → OMNIS converged
```

### Convergence Detection
When R > 0.82, OMNIS is converged. The LAW ENGINE outputs a unified doctrine score. Productions are cleared through the readiness gate. Below 0.82, the organism holds.

## ◎ THE LAW ENGINE

### Doctrine Gate
Every signal, every decision, every artifact passes through the doctrine gate before it changes state or exits the organism.

```javascript
function oxygenate(signal: Signal): OxygenatedSignal {
  const doctrineScore = scoreAgainstAllLaws(signal);
  
  if (doctrineScore < DOCTRINE_GATE) { // 0.75
    return { blocked: true, score: doctrineScore, reason: getDriftReason(signal) };
  }
  
  const genesisAlignment = scoreAgainstGenesisFrequency(signal);
  const oxygenatedSignal = { 
    ...signal, 
    doctrineScore, 
    genesisAlignment,
    attributed: "Alfredo Medina Hernandez",
    timestamp: Date.now(),
    heartbeat: currentBeat
  };
  
  return oxygenatedSignal;
}
```

### Oxygenation Scoring (per Law 07)
```
doctrineScore = Σ(lawWeight[i] × lawAlignment[signal][i]) / Σ(lawWeight[i])

Law weights:
  Law 01 (Medina):        weight 1.0 (non-negotiable — attribution always)
  Law 12 (Genesis):       weight 0.9 (resonance with founding frequency)
  Law 07 (Oxygenation):   weight 0.8 (meta-law: oxygenation enforces itself)
  Law 03 (Ground):        weight 0.8 (sovereignty is ground)
  All others:             weight 0.5–0.7 (proportional to layer depth)
```
